statement: The portable tool tier (tools/) must import the Python standard library only, so an agent in a bare workspace can run the mandatory verifiers immediately.

statement: Only app/excel/com_adapter.py and app/excel/session.py may import COM. Layers 3-10 depend on ExtractionPort so the pipeline stays testable off Windows.
source: constitution Part 44.2; enforced by tools/verify_architecture.py check_extraction_port

statement: GATE_PROTECTED_FILE_PROOF can only ever be satisfied by the COM adapter against a real protected workbook on Windows. No amount of fixture testing advances it.
An acceptance gate cannot pass on a sentence. Its evidence field must name a file that exists on disk, or the ledger validation fails.
source: constitution Part 38.2 rule 1; enforced by tools/gates.py _validate
